explanation: Compared against Green Problem 84: for infinitely many q, is there A ⊂ ℤ/q of size ∼ q^{1/3} with all nontrivial Fourier coefficients O(q^{1/6})? The statement reads ∼ as |A_q|/q^{1/3} → 1 along an infinite Q, with a uniform O-constant. In Green's informal usage ∼ might mean only order of magnitude, but the asymptotic reading is a stated, defensible choice. fourierMod correctly computes Σ_{a∈A} e(ar/q). Faithful.
